old_findings.evidence: Cross-gate review rejected by gate/round/static-contract binding.

Structured attestation and snapshot checks work; synthetic TSE-URL attestation still passes syntax, so official content/coverage requires human review.
Declared run files must be manifested and reviewer must attest completeness; undeclared used files and gate_contract.json snapshot presence require human verification.
Review digest and finding IDs linked to adjudication; changed review rejected.

new_findings.counterexample: Valid G0/G1 passes. Replace G0 reviewer with a different canonical UUID, update G0 review and adjudication review_sha256, leave both manifests and G1 run unchanged. G0 review hash changes but validate(plan,tmp_root) remains [].
new_findings.effect: A child gate remains approved after the concrete approval of its predecessor was replaced, contrary to the documented reopening rule.
new_findings.repair: Bind each dependency's approved review/adjudication digests, as well as manifest digest, in the child run and verify current records; reopen affected descendants.

mechanical_vs_human.mechanical: Canonical UUID syntax, gate/round/contract hashes, manifested run paths, review hash, predecessor manifest hash, external attestation structure and T2 applicability are checked.
mechanical_vs_human.human: Actual agent identity, complete used-file inventory and gate contract snapshot, official TSE publication and coverage, and substantive finding resolutions still require review.
